newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian airshow crash claims tenth victim.
newsitem.headline: Belgian airshow crash claims tenth victim.

text.p: A tenth person has died from injuries sustained when a plane performing aerobatics crashed into the crowd at an airshow in Ostend last month, BRTN radio reported on Friday.
The middle-aged man from Bruges was being treated for his injuries at Ghent University Hospital.
Eight people were killed instantly when the plane piloted by Captain Amr Hani Bilal of Jordan's Royal Air Force crashed on July 26. A ninth victim died in hospital a day later.
Investigators are still trying to establish the cause of the crash.
